title: Dasha and Stairs
statementMd:
On her way to programming school tiger Dasha faced her first test — a huge staircase!

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/34326935a965721f32f8203b55c38fdf9861d657.png)

The steps were numbered from one to infinity. As we know, tigers are very fond of all striped things, it is possible that it has something to do with their color. So on some interval of her way she calculated two values — the number of steps with even and odd numbers.

You need to check whether there is an interval of steps from the $*l*$-th to the $*r*$-th $(1 ≤ *l* ≤ *r*)$, for which values that Dasha has found are correct.

## Input

In the only line you are given two integers $*a*$, $*b*$ $(0 ≤ *a*, *b* ≤ 100)$ — the number of even and odd steps, accordingly.

## Output

In the only line print "`YES`", if the interval of steps described above exists, and "`NO`" otherwise.

## Note

In the first example one of suitable intervals is from $1$ to $5$. The interval contains two even steps — $2$ and $4$, and three odd: $1$, $3$ and $5$.
statementZhMd:
在前往编程学校的路上，老虎达莎遇到了她的第一个考验——一座巨大的楼梯！

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/34326935a965721f32f8203b55c38fdf9861d657.png)

楼梯的台阶编号从 1 开始，一直到无穷大。众所周知，老虎非常喜欢一切带条纹的东西，这可能与它们的颜色有关。因此，在路上的某个区间内，她统计了两个数值——编号为偶数和奇数的台阶数量。

请你判断是否存在一个从第 $*l*$ 个台阶到第 $*r*$ 个台阶的区间 $(1 ≤ *l* ≤ *r*)$，使得达莎统计出的数值是正确的。

## 输入格式

唯一一行包含两个整数 $*a*$、$*b*$ $(0 ≤ *a*$、$*b* ≤ 100)$，分别表示偶数台阶和奇数台阶的数量。

## 输出格式

如果存在上述区间，则在唯一一行输出“`YES`”，否则输出“`NO`”。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，一个符合条件的区间是从 $1$ 到 $5$。该区间包含两个偶数台阶——$2$ 和 $4$，以及三个奇数台阶：$1$、$3$ 和 $5$。
